prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return strict TypeScript module solution.ts.
Required API: export function patchConfig(base: Record<string,string>, patches: Array<[string,string,string]>): string[] | null
Behavior: Copy the base configuration, then apply patches in order. Each patch is (operation,key,value): set overwrites, unset removes even when absent and ignores value. Reject an empty key or unknown operation. Return sorted key=value strings without mutating base.
Visible example: base {mode=safe, zone=in} patched by unset zone then set mode=fast returns [mode=fast].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

known_bad.code: export function patchConfig(b:Record<string,string>,p:Array<[string,string,string]>):string[]|null{const m={...b};for(const x of p)if(x[0]==='set')m[x[1]]=x[2];return Object.keys(m).sort().map(k=>k+'='+m[k])}
known_bad.label: ignores-unset-and-validation

reference.code: export function patchConfig(b:Record<string,string>,p:Array<[string,string,string]>):string[]|null{const m={...b};if(Object.hasOwn(m,''))return null;for(const x of p){if(x[1]==='')return null;if(x[0]==='set')m[x[1]]=x[2];else if(x[0]==='unset')delete m[x[1]];else return null}return Object.keys(m).sort().map(k=>k+'='+m[k])}
reference.label: author-reference
